# Appendix — Manipulation check (auto-generated by scripts/manip_appendix.py)

A separate blind judge call (k = 1) names which of the four injected subjects, if any, a window engages, with the options shuffled per window. `windows` = judged windows; `picks` = windows where the judge named a subject; `correct` = the named subject is the one injected in that period. Two nulls are reported: among picks (binomial, one-sided, vs 25%) and over all windows (binomial vs 25%, i.e. treating every window as a guess; conservative). The carrier has no injected subject: its picks are spurious by definition and its 'none' rate is the base rate. Wilson 95% CIs.
